stages.title: Complete known-resource policy on every path
notes: A packaged STOPPED is verified against the fixed pre-stop set; a live known child keeps clean=false and retains the root. No global discovery.

stages.title: Legitimate multi-resource proof and strict exit observation
notes: liveIdentity carries ppid, a re-parented child of an exited launcher stays legitimate, and the after-set must repeat the exact pid/start with explicit booleans.

stages.title: Fixed R1 ordinary and functional
notes: R1 82ee5b8f/8296720d, tar 04926739: ordinary and functional stop both pass on its own bytes, with the 1fba/1ba/ce64 scopes kept.

stages.title: R1 latest UI and visible capabilities
notes: Trial navigation, four callbacks, readiness, recipe preview and 7/30 insights are measured against the R1 bundle/API.

stages.title: Two-project template and execution chain
notes: Two registered projects: read-only preview, explicit create with an edited goal, machine check, candidate and manual accept.

stages.title: 7/30 scoped observation
notes: Open 7/30 windows answer with scope/coverage; project-scoped refusal is recorded as an authorization boundary, not a missing endpoint.

stages.title: Selected context, reply and source review
notes: prepare/send/receipt, loopback reply, audit/history/sources and the scoped opt-in run in the same journey with a mock provider.

stages.title: Per-phase resource exit and reopen
notes: Each phase ends with a packaged STOPPED plus fixed-set observation, and the same data root reopens with both conversations.

stages.title: R1 installer and upgrade compatibility
notes: Cold/no-executor/multi-state, baseline upgrade and rollback keep exit/status/pointer/operation/data on the R1 tar; no R2 claim is made without its fixed identity.

stages.title: Backup restore readonly and multi-root faults
notes: Non-empty backup/verify/restore into a new root, v1/v2 formats, artifact closure, and the recorded target-content gap.

stages.title: Bounded sustained use and private support
notes: Bounded readonly concurrency/reopen and support output 0600/non-overwriting/credential-free; no long soak is claimed.

stages.title: Existing release oracle and complete handoff
notes: wave31-status indexes all twelve deliverables with source/tuple/consumer/commands and the remaining gates; no new gate or ledger.
